title: Drift Wood #22 · still there
logline: Two weeks later the envelope has moved. It has not been opened.

panels.composition: Wood's bedroom. CHLOE in the doorway with a stack of Timberline proofs. The envelope, now on the drawing table, under a jar of pens.

characters.pose: in the doorway, proofs under arm

balloons.text: Proofs. You're late. What's under the jar?

image.prompt: a teenage girl with a stack of newspaper proofs in a bedroom doorway, a boy at a drawing table with an envelope pinned under a jar of pens

panels.composition: Wood, sliding the jar an inch to cover more of it.

image.prompt: close-up of a hand sliding a jar of pens to cover more of an envelope on a drawing table

panels.composition: Chloe, reading the return address upside down from the door, because she can.

characters.pose: reading upside down from a distance

balloons.text: Reference material from the Pacific Northwest College of Art.

image.prompt: a teenage girl in a doorway reading an envelope's return address from across the room, narrow-eyed, a boy at the table looking away

panels.composition: Chloe drops the proofs on the bed and leaves. Wood alone. He lifts the jar. Looks. Puts it back.

characters.pose: lifting the jar, looking, replacing it

image.prompt: a teenage boy alone at a drawing table lifting a jar off an envelope, looking at it, and setting the jar back down, proofs on the bed behind, no words
